statements.chinese: 嘿，Monica，这个超辣的姑娘

statements.english: in Ross's building is flirting with me
statements.chinese: Ross所在大楼的某个人正在和我调情。

statements.english: Get in there man ! Flirt back , mix it up !
statements.chinese: 上啊兄弟！调情回去，活跃起来！

statements.english: Yeah , I-I-I'm down with that
statements.chinese: 好啊，我完全同意。

statements.english: Okay , here goes
statements.chinese: 好的，开始吧。

goes.definition: go（第三人称单数现在时）: 去

statements.english: How you a-doin'?
statements.chinese: 最近怎么样啊？

statements.english: It worked ! She's waving me over
statements.chinese: 成功了！她正招手叫我过去呢。

statements.english: Okay , I-I-I'll be right over . Let's see , she's on the third floor ..
statements.chinese: 好、好、好的，我马上就到。让我看看，她在三楼……

statements.english: Wow ! She is pretty , huh ?
statements.chinese: 哇！她真漂亮，是吧？

statements.english: Tell me about it , huh ?
statements.chinese: 可不是嘛，嗯？

statements.english: Oh no-no-no , I'm not with her
statements.chinese: 噢不不不，我跟她不是一伙的，

statements.english: that's just Monica !
statements.chinese: 这就是Monica的作风！

statements.english: Hey Joey ! Great stuff huh ?
statements.chinese: 嘿 Joey！很棒的东西对吧？

statements.english: This is your place ?
statements.chinese: 这是你的地方吗？

statements.english: Of course it is . Yeah , come on in
statements.chinese: 当然可以。来，快请进。

statements.english: Ooh-ooh , go by the window you can pretend to be surfing
statements.chinese: 哦哦，靠在窗边你可以假装在冲浪。

statements.english: But I counted
statements.chinese: 但我数过了，

statements.english: you're not supposed to live here ! Oh man !
statements.chinese: 你不该住在这儿的！天哪！

statements.english: What happened ?
statements.chinese: 发生什么事了？

statements.english: I ended up at Ross's place
statements.chinese: 我最终去了Ross那里。

statements.english: Oh , I must missed counted or something
statements.chinese: 哦，我肯定是数错了还是怎么的。

statements.english: Damn ! She's not there anymore
statements.chinese: 该死！她已经不在那儿了。

statements.english: Oh , l-l-look , Ross is doing his ' Watching TV ' bit
statements.chinese: 哦，快-快-快看，Ross正在表演他的‘看电视’桥段呢。

statements.english: No Joey , I think he's just watchin ' TV
statements.chinese: 不，Joey，我觉得他只是在看电视。

statements.english: We've lost visual contact with the suspect
statements.chinese: 我们已与嫌疑人失去视觉接触。

statements.english: Okay , now I've really have to go !
statements.chinese: 好了，现在我必须得走了！

statements.english: But it's just so unfair that our date has to get cut short
statements.chinese: 但我们的约会不得不提前结束，这真是太不公平了

statements.english: just because some guy shot at a store clerk
statements.chinese: 仅仅因为某个家伙朝店员开了枪。

statements.english: I know , but it's my job , sweethart !
statements.chinese: 我知道，但这是我的工作，亲爱的！

statements.english: Okay , then maybe I can come too !
statements.chinese: 好吧，那也许我也能一起去！

statements.english: Suspect has just emerged naked from the sewer
statements.chinese: 嫌犯刚从下水道赤身裸体地爬出来。

has.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 构成现在完成时

statements.english: All right , you go
statements.chinese: 好的，你去吧。

statements.english: - Bye bye . - Okay , bye bye
statements.chinese: - 再见。 - 好的，再见。

statements.english: Oh God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: Oh I just miss him so much !
statements.chinese: 天啊，我真是太想他了！

statements.english: For just a week you guys are really close , huh ?
statements.chinese: 你们才认识一周就这么亲密了，嗯？

statements.english: Yeah , it's weird
statements.chinese: 是啊，挺奇怪的。

statements.english: I can't help it though he's so sweet
statements.chinese: 尽管他如此温柔，我还是情不自禁。

statements.english: he's like this little puppy dog , y'know ?
statements.chinese: 他就像只小狗崽，你懂吧？

statements.english: But like a really tough one that shots bad guys
statements.chinese: 但是像一个真正强硬的射杀坏人的人。

statements.english: Ohh , I just love beginning parts of relationships , y'know ?!
statements.chinese: 啊，我就是超爱恋爱刚开始的阶段，懂吧？！

statements.english: You just like can't keep your hands off each other
statements.chinese: 你们就像不能把手从对方身上拿开一样。

statements.english: I know it is the best
statements.chinese: 我知道这是最好的。

statements.english: So-so how long did that last for you and Chandler ?
statements.chinese: 那你和Chandler这样不咸不淡的关系持续了多久？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: What ? It's still going on
statements.chinese: 什么？这事还在继续。

statements.english: Come on , seriously ! When did it end ?
statements.chinese: 拜托，认真的！什么时候结束的？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: I-I am serious , I mean , we're , we're all over each other all the time
statements.chinese: 我-我是认真的，我是说，我们，我们整天都腻在一起。

statements.english: Okay , you know where you are better than I do
statements.chinese: 好吧，你比我更清楚自己的处境。

statements.english: I was just curious
statements.chinese: 我只是好奇。

statements.english: What don't you just calm down Phoebe ! All right ?!
statements.chinese: Phoebe，你就不能冷静点吗！行不行？！

statements.english: Why don't you just get all your facts before you run around
statements.chinese: 在四处奔走之前，你为什么不先把所有事实搞清楚呢？

statements.english: telling everybody that you're the only hot couple !!
statements.chinese: 告诉所有人你们是唯一一对火辣的情侣！！

statements.english: God , I woke the beast
statements.chinese: 天哪，我把这头野兽吵醒了。

statements.english: I was wrong obviously , I just-I misspoke . It's okay
statements.chinese: 显然是我错了，我只是——说错了话。没关系。

statements.english: Oh no , it is okay , I mean as long as you know that
statements.chinese: 哦不，没关系，我的意思是只要你明白就好

statements.english: Chandler and I are also very hot and fiery , just as hot as you !
statements.chinese: Chandler和我也同样热情似火，跟你一样热烈！

statements.english: I mean our flame , whew , is on fire !
statements.chinese: 我是说我们的爱火，哇，正烧得炽热！

statements.english: Hey Monica , here's your broom back
statements.chinese: Monica，你的扫帚还给你。
